$comment: Hard gzip budgets are KiB limits for bundled+minified ESM with optional peers externalized. The exact reviewed byte map was re-measured for the 16.0.0 release on the final integrated source set with Node 22.23.2, esbuild's production minifier, and gzip level 9, via `node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs --print-budget-review`. Whole-byte ceilings are expressed in KiB; validation rejects a measurement above its reviewed byte count plus the 4% drift band, and these budgets deliberately take only 2% so ordinary growth still trips the gate. The 16.0.0 increase (+3.1% across the entries that moved, concentrated in data +11%, layout +8% and agent-tools +5%) is the reviewed cost of that release's added surface: the shared data-state renderer now used by table/data-grid/thread-list, lr-popover trigger modes with the hover bridge, lr-pagination's indeterminate server mode, lr-reorder-list's controlled mode, lr-menu-item type=radio, lr-responsive-panel side shapes, lr-chat-composer's stacked rail, and the eleventh built-in locale. Per-component routes are unaffected except where listed. The 2026-09-22 media-family review measured 205920 -> 206215 gzip bytes under Node 22.23.2 after the SVG clone resource guards and file-control corrections. Its ceiling increases by that same 295-byte implementation cost to 206442 bytes, retaining the previous 227-byte margin; all other ceilings retain their earlier review. The 2026-09-23 review for the 20.0.0 major remeasured every entry under Node 22.23.2 after the full-library remediation: settled-closed popups leave layout, render caps with localized notices, shared overlay-stack registration for floating previews, the lr-diff-view search/anchor surface, readonly/loading/appearance additions and the event renames with deprecated aliases. Each entry that moved above its ceiling now records its measured gzip bytes in $reviewedGzipBytes with a ceiling of that measurement plus 2%; untouched entries retain their earlier review.
